notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island Version 2.4
notes.notes:
Merry Chrismas to that one guy who really hated seeing Chel do her little puzzle-solving dance.

[b]Version 2.4 - December 22, 2024[/b]
[list][*] Added option to disable Chel and friends' animations during puzzles.[/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island Version 2.3
notes.notes:
Today we have some updates to the final boss, including a bugfix that I think was maybe introduced in one of the 2.X updates. Hopefully this resolves the issue:

[b]Version 2.3 - December 20, 2022[/b]
[list][*]Fixed issue with no items medal not unlocking during the final boss.
[*]Final boss HP down from six hearts to five.
[*]Added additional five seconds to attack phase.[/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island version 2.2
notes.notes:
This version introduces more fixes to the Japanese translation based on user feedback.

[b]Version 2.2 - February 25, 2022[/b]
[list][*]Further adjustments to Japanese translation.
[*]Fixed buttons for scrolling lore entries showing off-screen in Japanese version.[/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island 2.1
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who played the Japanese translation of Khimera: Puzzle Island! Today's update fixes some typos and mistakes in the dialogue.

[b]Version 2.1 - February 5, 2022[/b]
[list][*]Japanese language typo fixes.[/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island 2.0 - Japanese Translation
notes.notes:
[b]Khimera: Puzzle Island version 2.0 is now available![/b] This new version fixes a few bugs and introduces a [i]full Japanese translation[/i] by the wonderful [url=https://twitter.com/Realleii]Reallei[/url], making it the first Suits & Sandals game to be available in a language other than English!

Khimera: Puzzle Islandはバーション２.０に更新しました！不具合の修正他に、なんと！日本語も追加しました！これはSuits & Sandalsの初英語以外のリリースとなります！

[b]Version 2.0:[/b]
[list][*]Japanese translation introduced.
[*]Changed 'Skip cutscene' message to use button icons instead of text.
[*]fixed sound and music sometimes crackling as the game attempts to play the song and then immediately lower the volume.
[*]Fixed item medals not appearing in credits statistics.
[*]fixed all gold medal times achievement not unlocking if you were under one second from missing gold on any of the puzzles.
[*]Some Canadian spellings removed.
[*]Swapped flashing effect when selecting puzzles to something easier on the eyes. [/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island version 1.6
notes.notes:
Version 1.6 coming at you with a few minor fixes. Depending on your system, it may fix any fps issues you've been having.

[b]Version 1.6 - April 11, 2021[/b]
[list][*]Fixed timing issue causing the game to lock at 50 fps on some systems.
[*]Fixed typo in credits.
[*]Added functionality to enable/disable an FPS counter with F4.[/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island version 1.5
notes.notes:
A new version of [b]Khimera: Puzzle Island[/b] has been released today bringing with it a host of changes and additions dedicated to improving the keyboard/game pad experience.

[b]Version 1.5 - March 23, 2021[/b]
[list][*]Added functionality for EMPTY and NOTE buttons to close the achievement menu.
[*]Added option to adjust cursor speed in puzzles.
[*]Defaults for cursor speeds set to 25 and 5 from 30 and 6 for initial delay and subsequent delays respectively.
[*]Fixed not being able to select hints with keyboard/game pad when auto-hints are off.[/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island 1.4 - NEW MOSAIC
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39074026/c11bf953a450b971dd00fed1974f0ba8091d9d28.png[/img]

Version 1.4 has been released, adding a brand-new fourth mosaic and accompanying achievement! For everyone who enjoyed the game, this is for you!


[b]Version 1.4 - February 11, 2021[/b]
[list][*]4th mosaic added to the game featuring a mysterious guest.[/*][*]New achievement added for 4th mosaic.[/*][*]Added a 'random song' option to the settings menu; when active, a random stage theme will be chosen to play instead of the default theme. This can be activated independently for the main stages and mosaics.[/*][*]Fixed stage theme not loading ahead of time, causing a minor hiccup when the song starts during main stages.[/*][*]Mosaics are now displayed per-tile on the file select screen instead of per-mosaic.[/*][*]Completed items on the file select menu now light up.[/*][*]Modified how file % is calculated, counting individual mosaic tiles cleared rather than completed mosaics. Files with incomplete mosaics will see a drop in % due to the increased weight.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island version 1.3
notes.notes:
Version 1.3 has been released! This version features a new mechanic where the mouse cursor will affix itself to the x or y axis, allowing you to place markers in straight lines. If this kind of straight-edge lifestyle is absolutely [i]not[/i] your style, you can disable this new mechanic in the settings menu.

[b]Version 1.3 - December 7, 2020[/b]
[list][*]Wow more typos who would have ever guessed?[/*][*]Fixed discrepancy between all medals achievement check and gold medal display on puzzle menu.[/*][*]Fixed a few mosaic tiles that had more than one answer.[/*][*]Added auto-ruler, a mechanic which locks the cursor to the x or y axis when using the mouse, allowing you to easily place straight lines (can be deactivated in settings).[/*][/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Version 1.2 is now available! On top of a few more bug fixes, I've also added a few requested features including the ability to get through the victory fanfare quicker and an option to turn off text sounds. Thank you very much for your feedback and for playing my game!

I would also like to take a moment to let you guys know that the entire OST has been [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h34tHoeERuc&list=PLOP4a1jBgDNisQ-exPp6V_1pi6mMie3Jc]uploaded to YouTube[/url] for your listening pleasure. The videos were put together using the MP3s available via the official Soundtrack release on Steam so if you like what you hear, consider picking them up to have on the go:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1469770/Khimera_Puzzle_Island_Soundtrack/

[b]Version 1.2 - December 3, 2020[/b]
[list][*]More typos un-typo'd.[/*][*]Fixed pressing Escape on mosaic menu closing the game.[/*][*]Added missing tooltip to mouse button config in controls menu.[/*][*]Fixed being able to select locked puzzles and stages with keyboard controls.[/*][*]Fixed bug where game would lock up after doing a mosaic puzzle then going back to story mode.[/*][*]Fixed crash on piece selection menu related to keyboard controls.[/*][*]Fixed Chelshia's lore entry being available before it was intended to be unlocked.[/*][*]Fixed shop's opening dialogue remaining after exiting the shop.[/*][*]Added tooltips to the puzzle select menu.[/*][*]Added option to disable text sound effects.[/*][*]You can now skip through the win sequence by left clicking or pressing the assigned 'fill marker' button (default: A).[/*][/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Puzzle Island Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 is now live featuring a few small fixes to the shop and some spelling errors. Big thanks to everyone on the discord who's been pointing things out to me!


[b]Version 1.1 - December 1, 2020[/b]
[list][*]Fixed some typos.[/*][*]Fixed cursor vanishing on the right side of wide puzzles.[/*][*]Fixed shop not selling items if you had exactly enough cookies.[/*][*]Fixed pieces in shop displaying incorrectly as an empty marker instead of a note and vice versa.[/*][*]On boot, the game will now detect the largest possible resolution that will fit the display and default to that, rather than defaulting to 1x (if you've not already set a preference).[/*][/list]
